set.text: Saving energy is not difficult. If you turn off the lights when you leave a room, you use less electricity. A phone charger keeps using a little power even when nothing is connected. If you unplug it, it stops using power. Many families forget this simple step. Another good habit is to take shorter showers. If everyone in your house saves just five minutes a day, you will save a lot of water in a year. Finally, if you walk or ride a bike to school, you will make less pollution. Unless we change our daily habits, the planet will keep getting warmer. Small actions really do matter.
